name: 14843 · Hornell, NY
findings: ZIP 14843 (Hornell) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14843 (Hornell) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14843 (Hornell) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
